messages:
Nina: Heads-up: our SI partner (NorthBridge Systems) wants to run a full launch dry-run tomorrow for the joint marketplace listing + SI certification badge. They9re requesting an embargoed rehearsal and a final go/no-go at T-2hrs. Can PM, eng, ops, and marketing join at 09:00 PT?
Caleb: I can join at 09:00. Will bring the marketplace packaging checklist and the badge assets.
Ravi: 09:00 works. Quick Q: are we doing a pre-provisioned badge (partners-only) or flipping public visibility during publish? We should decide now so ops can script the toggle.
Paula: Pre-provision partners-only; flip public at publish time. Ops, please prepare a rollback plan if the listing fails ingestion.
ops-bot: Note: feature-flag found: `si_marketplace_publish` in deployment pipeline. Default: false.
Caleb: We9ll run the demo in the staged announce environment (staging-pub-2026). Last time we saw stale cache on the tile; Ravi please invalidate CDN cache as part of the dry run.
Ravi: Will add cache-invalidate step to the runbook. Also attaching a minimal script snippet for the flip: ```bash
# flip flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" https://deploy.redwood.internal/flags/si_marketplace_publish
```
Nina: Great. Marketing needs final copy by 10:30 PT to assemble social and press assets. Partner legal cleared the quote but wants the partner9s compliance blurb included. Can marketing send copy under embargo to partner for sign-off?
Paula: Yes, marketing can share under NDA. Assign marketing as the single approver for social images; assign PM to approve technical SKU and certified integration notes.
Caleb: I9ll approve SKUs. Attaching the certified HW SKUs for the listing: RDW-EDGE-A1, RDW-ACC-2, RDW-TPU-XL.
Ravi: Thanks. Ops, during the rehearsal can we simulate a failed ingestion and run the rollback so the partner sees the recovery flow?
ops-bot: Suggest simulated failure window at T+2 minutes with immediate rollback to partners-only badge state.
Paula: Good idea. Include these steps in the rehearsal timeline: 1) intros & checklist, 2) controlled demo, 3) flag flip dry-run, 4) simulate ingestion failure & rollback, 5) retrospective. Keep commentary short during the run.
Nina: Please drop the rehearsal deck and final checklist in this thread before EOD. Also: embargo time is 15:00 UTC tomorrow. Do not share outside the invited list.
Caleb: Deck will be in the calendar event and I9ll paste a one-pager here.
Ravi: ops runbook snippet added to calendar. I9ll handle flip and cache invalidate.
Paula: Partner PM will join the final 10 minutes for alignment post-rehearsal.
Nina: Thanks everyone. Meeting invite created. See you tomorrow 09:00 PT sharp.
Caleb: \ud83d\udc4d
Ravi: \ud83d\udc4d
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "SI launch dry-run - NorthBridge" 09:00 PT. Invites: Nina, Caleb, Ravi, Paula, partner-pm@northbridge
